scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run check:publish-specifiers && pnpm run test
scripts.dev: pnpm run dev:prepare && nuxi dev --cwd playground --dotenv ../.env.local
scripts.dev:prepare: pnpm run build && pnpm run prepare:playground && pnpm run prepare:convex
scripts.prepare:convex: pnpm --dir playground exec convex dev --once --typecheck disable --tail-logs disable
scripts.lint: pnpm run check:component-auth-boundaries && pnpm run check:convex-surface && pnpm run check:installer-bridge-boundary && pnpm run check:live-mcp-tokens && pnpm run check:cms-contract-vendor && pnpm run check:docs:install-story && pnpm run check:public-vocabulary && pnpm run check:compatibility-matrix && pnpm run check:current-content-model && pnpm run check:stale-surfaces && eslint packages test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @lupinum/ginko-cms-contract typecheck && pnpm --filter @lupinum/ginko-cms-convex typecheck && pnpm --filter @lupinum/ginko-cms typecheck
scripts.test:public-content: vitest run test/shared/contracts.test.ts test/shared/mcp-tools.test.ts test/shared/studio-workflow.test.ts test/runtime/studio-workflow-components.test.ts test/component/diagnostics.test.ts test/component/import.test.ts
scripts.release:verify: pnpm run check && pnpm run package:e2e && pnpm run audit:prod
scripts.release:verify:registry: pnpm run check && pnpm run package:e2e:registry && pnpm run audit:prod
scripts.release:publish: node -e "console.error('Direct publish scripts are disabled. Run release:verify and release:pack, inspect .pack, then follow MAINTAINING.md.'); process.exit(1)"
